title: Diagnostic test drain distinguishes timeout from injected writer loss
outcome: Diagnostic test drain distinguishes timeout from injected writer loss
acceptance: A completion drain requires one newly requested and acknowledged generation and an unchanged timeout counter; a false caused by timeout cannot satisfy an injected I/O or lock-loss assertion after a late acknowledgement
Deterministic tests cover late acknowledgement after timeout and early return without a new generation, while preserving production exit behavior and exact loss and retained-record assertions

completion.summary: Diagnostic test drains now reject timeouts after late acknowledgement and early returns without a new flush generation; deterministic regressions preserve exact loss and retained-record assertions.
